verdict.rationale: Docs describe privacy controls—filtering providers by data policy, opting out of training-data use, and enterprise in-region routing (docs-12,13,25,33)—but community feedback explicitly disputes true zero-data-retention guarantees ('No ZDR. No dice.' and 'no true guarantees of ZDR/privacy/data sovereignty'), and notes ZDR-only toggles limit which discounts/providers apply, suggesting retention controls are partial and inconsistently honored across providers.
